title: sessions.json (v5 on-disk write shape)
description: The repository's numbered session ledger, written only by the sanctioned writers in ai_router/writers.py. A repository has sessions, not sets of sessions: there is no name above the list and no lifecycle state above a session, because a repository is never 'complete'. Cancellation is per-session in v5, and preCancelStatus rides on the record it belongs to so a restore returns that session -- and only that session -- to where it was.

schemaVersion.description: v5 collapsed the set level out. v4 files are read once by the migration and never written again.

sessions.description: The canonical per-session ledger, ordered by number.

forceClosed.description: Opaque passthrough set by close --force; preserved across rewrites.

nextOrchestrator.description: Recommendation for the next session, written at close.

status.description: v5 admits 'cancelled' here because there is no longer a set to carry it.

preCancelStatus.description: Where a cancelled session came from. A re-cancel never overwrites it.

type.description: Absent means 'work'; the writer persists only non-work values.

verificationVerdict.description: Canonical tokens are VERIFIED / ISSUES_FOUND / REMEDIATED_AT_CAP (plus the retired WAIVED, still read from historical records and refused by every writer). Typed string rather than enum because operators have shipped extension tokens that readers PREFIX-MATCH; the sanctioned writer (verdict.validate_session_verdict) fails closed against an exact allowlist, so a confabulated non-verdict can never persist here. Readers stay lenient; the writer is strict.

verification.description: The round summary that must ride with the verdict: verifier identity, round count, cost. Shape owned by the verification writer.

orchestratorBlock.description: Omit-null: missing keys are valid; null values and 'unknown' placeholders are not. identityProvenance is derived from the engine by build_orchestrator_block and is never a free choice. 'provider' is a seat DESCRIPTOR; the effective provider is derived at use time by registry lookup on 'model'.

identityProvenance.description: How identity was established: 'asserted' for multi-provider engines (Copilot seats), 'direct' for single-vendor engines.

seatSessionIds.description: The seat conversation ids that produced this session, in first-seen order. ACCUMULATES -- start is idempotent and is re-run after a context reset, which starts a new conversation on the same session. Absent (never [] and never null) on a Direct-API run: 'not captured' and 'captured, and there were none' are different claims.
